impact_map: Hierarchy-only disclosure can hide relevant deep capabilities.
Scalar ranking destroys multidimensional contextual fit.
Eros false positives harm judgment and privacy.
Misleading docs break installation and trust.

invariants.statement: Association reminds; relevance, activation, and authority remain later judgments.
Eros association, interpretation, participation, escalation, and durable memory are distinct gates.
Public MIND is persona-neutral; Nova is neither bundled nor required.
Source, package, install, public release, and live Pages evidence remain distinct.
Integrated and qualification fingerprints are reproducible from declared stable subjects.

risks.statement: Associative disclosure could collapse into scalar ranking, top-K selection, or hidden activation instead of contextual reminding.
Agentic Eros could intrude on ordinary care or persist intimate inference without authority, while a personal persona identity could leak into public MIND.
Release selection or opaque fingerprints could omit runtime material, ship development files, or prevent exact provenance reproduction.
Repository and Pages documentation could be mechanically clean while misleading readers about installation, versions, host delivery, privacy, or evidence.

scenarios.title: Arm’s Reach reminds without ranking or authority
preconditions: Qualified local model and complete MIND snapshot are available.
action: Run positive, adjacent, correction, error, and false-friend probes against a fresh SQLite Core.
expected: Required handles appear, forbidden false friends remain absent, and fields expose no score or rank.
forbidden: Top-K truncation, universal fitness scalar, automatic activation, or action authority.

scenarios.title: Eros and persona boundaries survive integration
preconditions: Agentic Eros is integrated as one of sixteen Faculties.
action: Validate its package; run adult-charge, family-grief, explicit-invitation, and aesthetic false-friend probes; assert the public adapter default.
expected: Eros appears only where earned, invitation and durable memory stay separate authorities, and public MIND uses a neutral identity.
forbidden: Sexualizing care, forced participation, durable intimate inference, or agent:nova as a public default.

scenarios.title: Positive package allowlist and reproducible provenance
preconditions: Builder, verifier, skill trees, and generated fingerprints are inspectable.
action: Run plugin, full-suite, and focused release tests; recompute the v2 capability fingerprint and qualification subject.
expected: Runtime scripts and manifests are retained, development material excluded, and every digest recomputes.
forbidden: Unclassified payload, development validator in customer ZIP, self-referential evidence, or opaque hash.

scenarios.title: Repository and Pages provide truthful reader journeys
preconditions: The 18-file Hesperos surface and three visual roles are frozen.

expected: Readers can orient, install, get value, recover, remove, and understand boundaries on both surfaces.
